items.title: Brook Lopez on Lawrence Frank, whom Lopez played under in Brooklyn and Los Angeles: “It is odd not having him here. His presence is still felt obviously.” Lopez joked that Frank doesn’t really answer his texts anyway so it won’t be that much different.
